node.statement: By the registered definition def-extended-delta-inclusion, an extended C_E*epsilon-isomorphism is a single bijective linear map v whose every amplification 1_{M_n} tensor v is a C_E*epsilon-inclusion. Thus the map in node 1.2 carries A at all amplification levels with the same constant; node 1.1 makes that constant and epsilon_E universal and independent of all dimension and block data. Since A and epsilon in node 1.2 were arbitrary, the asserted universal conclusion follows.
